title: Relative clauses: free practice
instructionEs: Escribe, transforma y corrige las frases.

items.text: I have a friend ___ speaks five languages.
items.explanationEs: Una persona, y el relativo es el sujeto de speaks: who (o that).

items.text: Is this the bag ___ you lost?
items.explanationEs: Una cosa: which (o that). Aquí también se podría quitar: the bag you lost.

items.text: My grandmother, ___ is 90, still walks every day.
items.explanationEs: Una persona y con comas (información extra): who. Con comas no se usa that.

items.text: That's the restaurant ___ we had dinner last week.

items.sentence: The people which work here are very friendly.
items.explanationEs: Para personas, who (o that), no which.

items.sentence: Lima, that is the capital of Peru, is a big city.
items.explanationEs: Con comas no se usa that; para una cosa o un lugar, which.
